environment: headless Chromium; real App/MobileApp and personal modules; synthetic native/Capacitor test doubles, not device acceptance
checks: desktop: composition Enter, immediate compositionend submit and keyCode 229 do not create; a later intentional Enter creates exactly once and restores focus
desktop: clock-driven regrouping is deferred while editing, so crossing date boundaries does not remount or erase the inline draft
desktop: consecutive entry clears all saved fields and retains focus; notes allow line breaks, optional deadline is separate from daily arrangement
desktop: todo/in-progress/completed/reopen use one task identity and the same completed fold
desktop: inline title/notes and clearing the optional deadline preserve status and task identity
desktop: unknown inline edits keep frozen input and expose a local retry with the original command
desktop: an unrelated edit preserves the original instant/zone; explicit same-day date replacement converts only when requested
desktop: editing old waiting tasks retains raw status, waiting flag and existing context
desktop: a stale inline version rejects without overwriting another edit or replacing the local draft during sync
desktop: unknown create result freezes the input and retries the identical task/operation/time once
desktop: definite create rejection keeps editable input; explicit reread retains the draft before a new attempt
desktop: a committed create plus failed read retries only the read and retains the saved task ID
desktop: project detail shares continuous entry and state edits; old hierarchy entry remains available and homepage shows the same task/state
desktop: light/dark themes, reduced motion and inline editor fit the viewport without an assignee control
